baseline_v0.notes: Original prompt in pipeline.py with verify_rounds=2

planner_v1.notes: Rules for write after read, slot ambiguity ask, and self-cancellation. Ask F1 jumped 0.0810->0.1989 (+145%), Mean F1 +0.0406

planner_v2.notes: Minimal arguments rule reduced WRONG_TOOL_OR_ARGS from 53 down to 41 (-22.6%).

planner_v3.notes: Empty F1 reached 0.6364 (highest), but Ask F1 dropped to 0.0492 due to prompt bloat and diluted attention on ask_missing_info.

planner_v4.notes: Minimal Surgery on planner_v1: All-time high Mean F1 0.3597 (+0.0480 vs baseline) and Act F1 0.3831. Missed ask dropped to 8 (2.7%). Net +22 samples improved vs baseline. (CURRENT CHAMPION PROMPT)

planner_v5.notes: Ask F1 rebounded strongly from 0.0492 to 0.1632. Wrong Tool/Args held strong at 42 (14.0%). 4 samples crashed with VLLMValidationError due to max_ctx overflow (fixed in pipeline.py).

planner_v4_guarded.notes: Safe Hash Guard & Schema Validator integrated directly into pipeline: Ambiguity Guard (catches >1 contact/bike lookups), Vague Slot Guard ('chút tiền' without numbers -> sys.ask_missing_info), English room mapping ('living room' -> 'phòng khách'), Parameter Hygiene. Reaches new record Mean F1 0.3760 and Ask F1 0.3100 (+135%).

mapper_v1.notes: Specialized prompt for Qwen3-0.6B dialect mapper to normalize North/Central/South dialectal words ('chiều ni', 'chừ', 'buồng ngủ', 'kênh nớ') into standard Vietnamese while preserving entities, quantities, and timestamps intact.
